title: Self-Evolving Harness on Multiple Tasks with the Agent as Its Own Optimizer
abstract: arXiv:2609.38372v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A harness is the code around a language-model agent that organizes prompts, calls tools, manages context, and controls execution. As models grow stronger, recent work has begun to let agents improve their own harnesses, a line of work known as self-evolving harnesses. In most existing methods, a separate proposer running on a human-designed harness modifies the solver's harness, and a separate harness is evolved for each benchmark. Real-world tasks come from many domains, so both the evolution and the evaluation of a harness should cover a diverse range of tasks. We propose a framework close to recursive self-improvement: the same frozen model, on the same version of the harness, first solves tasks as the solver and then, as the proposer, reads the complete run records and directly edits the harness that runs it. translated_title: 以智能体作为自身优化器的多任务自进化执行框架
translated_abstract: 执行框架是围绕语言模型智能体的代码，负责组织提示词、调用工具、管理上下文并控制执行过程。随着模型能力的不断增强，近期研究开始让智能体改进自身的执行框架，这一研究方向被称为自进化执行框架。在大多数现有方法中，由一个运行在人工设计框架上的独立提议者来修改求解器的框架，并且需要为每个基准测试单独进化一个框架。然而，现实世界的任务来自多个领域，因此执行框架的进化和评估都应当覆盖多样化的任务。我们提出了一个接近递归自我改进的框架：同一个冻结模型在相同版本的框架上运行，首先作为求解器完成任务，随后作为提议者读取完整的运行记录，并直接编辑运行它自身的框架。每个进化批次从五个不同领域的基准测试中抽取任务。为衡量泛化能力，训练与留出测试……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出让同一个冻结模型兼任求解器与提议者的自进化执行框架，智能体在覆盖五个不同领域基准的多任务上直接编辑运行自身的框架代码，实现接近递归自我改进的效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-evolving harness framework in which the same frozen model serves as both solver and proposer, directly editing the harness that runs itself on tasks drawn from five benchmarks across different domains, achieving performance close to recursive self-improvement.
